tools.name: create_video
tools.description: Generate a short AI video with synced sound from a text prompt using Epic Video. Videos are 5, 15, 30, 60 or 120 seconds long; anything over 15 seconds is stitched from chained 5-second clips for consistency. tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Check the status of an Epic Video generation job by its job id. Returns the status (queued, rendering, upscaling, done, or failed) and, when done, the video URL.

tools.name: list_my_videos
tools.description: List the signed-in Epic Video user's finished videos, newest first, with playback URLs.

tools.name: get_my_usage
tools.description: Show the signed-in Epic Video user's plan tier, plan tokens left in the current rolling 7-day window and this month, top-up (bonus) token balance, and per-second token rates (1 token/sec at 480p, 2 tokens/sec at 720p).

tools.name: list_characters
tools.description: List the Epic Video characters available to the signed-in user — their own locked characters plus shared presets — for use with create_video's character_id.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "create_video" is 1097 chars, far longer than this server's median (161). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.
